closing.text: Worth knowing: WhataHotel's preferred rate includes complimentary breakfast for two each day, priority for an upgrade at check-in when one is available, free Wi-Fi access, and a $100 credit at the hotel per stay, or $200 for suites. It can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to the terms of each offer.
